Lobo Gris's core beers are Aullido (lager clara), Colmillo (IPA) and Luna Negra (stout); Luis's 2025 brand fee was $68,000 MXN + IVA, half up front.

Colmillo IPA is 6.8% ABV and 62 IBU (lote 14); Aullido 4.8% ABV, 18 IBU; Luna Negra 5.9% ABV, 35 IBU. Writes ABV with a decimal point.

2026 picks: May Hamish, June Ife (Salt Year, a novel by Ruth Kinsella), July Sunita, December Luis.
